name: Paragon Electronic Systems
old_description: Paragon Electronic Systems, Inc. is a top performing New England based Rep Firm for high tech electronic components and system level solutions.
about:
Paragon Electronic Systems, Inc. operates from Manchester, New Hampshire, where it was founded in 2006 by Jeff Routhier and Chris Pearson. The company began as a manufacturer's representative firm focused on high-technology electronic components and system-level solutions for the New England market.

As a manufacturer's representative, Paragon does not manufacture products but provides technical sales engineering support for a balanced portfolio that includes semiconductors, passives, power, interconnect, electro-mechanical, and system-level solutions. The firm's inside sales team and executive staff coordinate with principals to offer optical coatings and EM filtering solutions for military and aerospace applications, rad-hard and space-level components, battery pack assemblies, cable assemblies, enclosures, and custom electronic packaging for rad-hard space applications.

The company serves customers across military/aerospace, space, and defense verticals, engaging early in project cycles to provide component selection and system-level expertise. Its sales engineers work with OEMs and prime contractors throughout New England on programs requiring high-reliability electronic components.

Paragon emphasizes a high level of service backed by more than 20 years of industry experience, positioning its dedicated technical professionals as an extension of both principal manufacturers and customer engineering teams.

name: Parish Foods LLC
old_description: Parish Foods is a Louisiana-based sauce and seasoning co-manufacturer specializing in small-batch and scalable production for emerging and established brands. We handle product development, packaging and labels, and manufacturing under one roof, giving founders a clear path from recipe to market-ready product.
about:
Parish Foods LLC operates from Rayne, Louisiana, as a sauce and seasoning co-manufacturer serving emerging and established food brands. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but it positions itself as a one-stop partner for founders moving from recipe to market-ready product.

The company produces sauces and dressings (barbecue sauce, hot sauce, salsa, pasta sauce, marinades, ketchup, mustard, and global varieties), seasonings and rubs (all-purpose blends, Cajun and Creole mixes, dry rubs), and dry batters and mixes (fish fry, breading, pancake and waffle mixes). Manufacturing uses hot-fill and cold-fill processes with filling, sealing, batch coding, and case packing performed in-house. Parish Foods describes its scale as small-batch to scalable production, though facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not published.

Customers include startup founders and established brands seeking private-label or co-packed food products for retail and foodservice distribution. The company works with clients across the sauce, seasoning, and dry-mix categories, handling everything from formulation and compliance labeling to FDA and Louisiana regulatory registrations.

Parish Foods emphasizes a unified service model that combines product development, packaging selection, label design, and manufacturing under one roof. Its five-phase onboarding process typically spans two months, after which production lead times run approximately two weeks from order approval. The company states it was built to give food entrepreneurs a clear path from concept to commercial product.

name: Park Bench Apparel
old_description: Was established in 2003 beginning with screen printing and embroidery services near Rapid City, South Dakota.
about:
Park Bench Apparel operates from Black Hawk, South Dakota, near Rapid City. The business was established in 2003 as A&J Screening, starting with screen printing and embroidery services before expanding into a broader range of creative production.

Today the company provides screen printing up to 14 colors, heat transfers using UAF Aqua Fusion technology, embroidery, appliqué, laser engraving and cutting, UV printing, wide-format printing, stickers and decals, graphic design and web store setup, dye-sublimation cut-and-sew uniforms, white-label printing and shipping, and bagging, folding, and UPC finishing. The production crew and designers bring decades of combined experience, though facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Clients include sports organizations such as the Rush Hockey program and events like the Lakota Nation Invitational, along with businesses seeking custom apparel, promotional products, and uniform programs. The white-label fulfillment service targets brands and retailers that need outsourced production and shipping.

The company emphasizes fresh, original designs and streamlined fulfillment through its white-label offering, positioning itself as a single source for decorated apparel and branded merchandise.

name: Park Central Metal Fabricators
old_description: We are a leading metal fabrication and custom design shop serving the Metro Atlanta area since 1993.
about:
Park Central Metal Fabricators, a family-owned metal fabrication shop, was established in 1993 in Doraville, Georgia, and has served the metro Atlanta area for over three decades. The business began as a custom design and fabrication operation focused on commercial HVAC, residential HVAC, and specialty metal repair.

Today the shop offers a range of processes including sheet metal fabrication, welding (TIG/MIG on stainless steel, aluminum, and steel), plasma cutting, forming and bending, milling and machining, and fiber laser cutting. It produces commercial HVAC sheet metal components, custom fabricated parts, and specialty one-off items, with the capacity to handle both single-piece prototypes and long production runs. The company also manufactures metal production and manufacturing items, producing almost any kind of stainless or galvanized metal parts. Specific facility size, employee count, and annual volume figures are not publicly disclosed.

The client base spans Fortune 100 corporations, local contractors, artisans, and residential homeowners. Industries served include commercial and residential HVAC, general metal fabrication, and specialty fabrication for diverse applications.

According to the company, its distinguishing factors are a strong focus on quality, a customer-first philosophy, and the versatility to deliver projects on schedule using quality processes and metals. The firm states that its passion and dedication to quality of work are matched by its commitment to understanding that the customer comes first.

name: Parker Plastics Inc
old_description: Parker Plastics – delivering customer driven packaging solutions since 1989
about:
Parker Plastics Inc, headquartered in Pleasant Prairie, Wisconsin, was founded in 1989. The company operates four manufacturing facilities in Pleasant Prairie, Wisconsin; Sand Springs, Oklahoma; Hagerstown, Maryland; and North Las Vegas, Nevada.

Parker Plastics specializes in custom blow molding, offering PET and extrusion manufacturing across 47 production lines. The company also provides co-extrusion for multi-layer HDPE containers, hot-fill capabilities up to 200°F, HPP and aseptic-compatible bottles, in-house decoration (pressure-sensitive, sleeve labeling, heat transfer), and warehousing at each facility. All resins are FDA-compliant and BPA-free.

The company serves food and beverage markets including honey and agave, dressings and sauces, mustard and condiments, specialty beverages, edible oils, liquor and mixer bottles, as well as household chemicals, agricultural chemicals, food service, pharmaceutical and medical, and home and office water.

Parker Plastics emphasizes a customer-driven model built on flexibility and responsiveness, offering custom container programs, just-in-time delivery, and stocking programs. Its quality system is SQF-certified at all four plants and tailored to client specifications, supported by an ERP system for custom labeling and tracking.

name: Pars Auto Parts
old_description: Founded in 1988 Pars Auto Parts has grown to be one of the largest independent Auto Parts and Lubricants Distributor in Southern California.
about:
Founded in 1988 in Huntington Beach, California, Pars Auto Parts grew into one of the largest independent distributors of auto parts and lubricants in Southern California. The company operates as a direct distributor for several major U.S. manufacturers.

The company stocks a diverse line of automotive lubricants, including synthetic blend motor oils (API GF-5 SN+ rated in 5W-20, 5W-30, 10W-30), full synthetic motor oils (SAE grades 0W16, 0W20, 5W20, 5W30, 10W30, GM Dexos 1 licensed), multi-grade 15W40 diesel engine oil, and transmission fluids such as MD-3 ATF and ATF FullSyn multi-vehicle fluid. Pars Auto Parts provides warehousing and distribution services across the region, with financing options of 30 days at zero interest.

Pars Auto Parts serves automotive repair shops, dealerships, fleet operators, and industrial customers throughout Southern California. Its customer base includes independent garages and commercial fleets requiring steady supplies of engine oils, transmission fluids, and specialty lubricants. The company emphasizes monthly promotional pricing on select products.

Pars Auto Parts states that its commitment to honesty, quality, and value distinguishes it in the market, along with its status as a direct distributor for large national brands, which it says ensures product authenticity and supply reliability.

name: PartWerx Automotive
old_description: When drivers in Durham are looking for an estimate on auto parts they call PartWerx Automotive. Since 2017, PartWerx Automotive has been delivering competitively priced auto parts to the Durham area.
about:
PartWerx Automotive is headquartered in Garner, North Carolina, and was established in 2017 to address a gap in the market for a quality-focused distributor of aftermarket auto body parts that also delivered exceptional service in the Garner area. The company operates from 1035 N Greenfield Parkway and serves collision repair shops across a wide swath of central North Carolina.

The business distributes aftermarket auto body parts at competitive prices and runs an online store where collision shop owners can create accounts, browse inventory, purchase parts, and have them delivered directly. PartWerx closed its Charlotte location but continues to deliver throughout the Raleigh, Greensboro, and surrounding regions, including Garner, Clayton, Durham, Harrisburg, Lincolnton, Denver, Mooresville, Monroe, Albemarle, Concord-Kannapolis, Shelby, Gastonia, and Salisbury.

Its customers are primarily auto body collision repair shops, ranging from multi-shop operators to independent local body shops. The company emphasizes that it understands the collision repair business and the urgency of getting vehicles back on the road safely and quickly.

PartWerx was started because the founders saw a strong need for a provider that combined quality aftermarket parts with outstanding service. Their motto, "Outstanding Quality - Exceptional Service," reflects a stated focus on responsiveness and reliability rather than scale.

name: Parts Direct Warehouse
old_description: Parts Direct was started in 2013 to provide the highest quality parts and service to the NW suburbs of Chicago. We search high and low for the best parts with the lowest warranty rates in the industry.
about:
Parts Direct Warehouse was founded in 2013 in Crystal Lake, Illinois, as a family-owned wholesale auto parts supplier targeting the northwest suburbs of Chicago. His partner, Mike, began his career delivering auto parts while in college, mastering pricing, inventory management, and operations. Together they launched Parts Direct to deliver high-quality components with the lowest warranty rates in the market.

The company operates as a distributor of powertrain components, transmissions, and under-car/hood parts, sourcing from manufacturers to serve automotive repair shops and fleet operators. Its Crystal Lake facility supports 24/7 online ordering for under-car and under-hood categories, and a delivery fleet that the founders personally vet for reliability. While specific facility size and headcount are not disclosed, the operation emphasizes rapid turnaround and inventory accuracy.

Primary customers are independent repair shops and small automotive businesses throughout the Chicagoland area. The founders position themselves as fellow small business owners who understand the pressure of every penny and minute, tailoring their stock to the needs of local technicians who require dependable transmissions, radiators, and related components.

Parts Direct differentiates itself by focusing on warranty performance — seeking parts with the lowest return rates — and by offering direct access to the founders for technical guidance and problem solving. The company’s stated mission is to eliminate comebacks and provide a streamlined ordering experience backed by decades of combined industry experience.

name: Patience Metal Fab
old_description: We are a team of automotive enthusiasts and fabrication specialists that take customer’s concepts, ideas and dreams and make them into reality. We have experience in working with
about:
Patience Metal Fab operates from Brooklyn Center, Minnesota, and was founded in 2012. The shop began as a team of automotive enthusiasts and fabrication specialists focused on turning customer concepts into finished vehicles, earning a reputation across the Midwest as the “Last Stop Fab Shop” for completing projects other shops could not.

The company provides a range of fabrication services including MIG and TIG welding of aluminum, steel, and stainless steel; lathe and mill machining; tube bending; sheet-metal forming with brakes, bead rollers, slip rolls, and an English wheel; and composite and lightweight-alloy work. In-house capabilities extend to 3D scanning, CFD simulation, certified roll-cage construction, custom chassis fabrication, exhaust systems, forced-induction plumbing, engine swaps, and aero design. The shop reports more than 20,000 hours of cage and chassis fabrication experience.

Patience Metal Fab serves the motorsports and street-rod segments, working with individual builders, race teams, and restoration projects. Past projects include a NASA AIX/SU Mustang, a Camaro ZL1 LE built for Nick Plocienik, a Volkswagen MK2 VR6 nicknamed “Waskly,” and a 1950s Ford F1 restomod known as “Gramps.”

The business was started to address a gap in the market for a fabrication shop that could handle unique, difficult builds and see them through to completion, a mission reflected in its “Last Stop Fab Shop” moniker and its emphasis on 3D scanning and simulation to validate designs before cutting metal.
